en: Dependent on a wholesome state accompanied by rapture (*pītisahagata*), a state that is neither accompanied by rapture nor wholesome arises by way of root-condition (*hetupaccaya*) ... [In the case of root-condition: three; ... [and so on] ... up to non-disappearance: three.

Dependent on an unwholesome state accompanied by rapture, a state that is neither accompanied by rapture nor unwholesome arises by way of root-condition ... [In the case of root-condition: three; ... [and so on] ... up to non-disappearance: three. (For the indeterminate root, there are likewise only three conditions.)
